question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin add BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, and should that behavior be opt-in or default-on?
rationale: The issue is valid, but implementing it changes an official memory plugin’s config surface, retrieval semantics, index lifecycle, and fallback policy, which are product and compatibility choices rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Opt-In Plugin Parity
options.body: Keep this issue open and approve an opt-in hybrid mode with vector-only fallback, FTS lifecycle handling, and focused tests/docs.

options.title: Default-On Hybrid
options.body: Approve hybrid retrieval as the default, but require explicit upgrade proof for FTS index creation, fallback behavior, and score/duplicate-threshold changes.

options.title: Route To ClawHub
options.body: Close the core-repo item and leave enhanced LanceDB retrieval to external plugins such as memory-lancedb-pro instead of changing the official plugin.

recommendation.title: Opt-In Plugin Parity
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and approve an opt-in hybrid mode with vector-only fallback, FTS lifecycle handling, and focused tests/docs.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest current-source and prior-review connection to this exact issue and memory-lancedb surface.
